answer: Each identity borrows one of 2,000 violet-sealed relics from the karst archive, locking a 70-credit bond. The k-th loan costs 24+6(k-1) per epoch; 1,000 fakes pay 3,021,000 rent and lock 70,000. One relic, one loan; return by epoch close, violet seal intact, or late return, broken seal, or double booking burns it. Auditors replay the karst loan log, catching a rented-relic ring. Honest agents pay 24 per epoch, reclaiming the bond on clean return.
